r86 diagnostic-only compute-cache telemetry, 2026-10-18.

Implementation changed ONLY linux_supervisor.py. Root's CUDA_CACHE_MAXSIZE=4294967296 in xt_services.py is left untouched and rebound by its current hash in provenance.
status.compute_cache now records startup, mt_ready, and shutdown cache snapshots of existing ~/.nv/ComputeCache (file count and byte total). Explicit recovery --cleanup adds shutdown_cleanup while preserving earlier snapshots. Shutdown inspection happens AFTER owned process/GPU cleanup. Metadata traversal has a1second time budget, no symlink traversal or file-content reads; partial counts/errors are explicitly diagnostic, never a new run failure. Cache path/contents/permissions are not changed.
For launched ASR/MT service children, child_environment records only CUDA_CACHE_MAXSIZE, PID and start_ticks. The PID must match the supervisor's known owned identity both before and after reading /proc/<pid>/environ. No other environment value is recorded. Missing/exited/malformed values are diagnostic, not startup refusal. This reads the actual service child's variable; it does not prove GPU-driver cache hits or accepted cache capacity.
No extra GPU probe, model import, model run, test, build, app start or cache mutation. Existing guard probes and cleanup behavior remain.
